podcast.title: Solo Album
podcast.body: This solo record included the song "The East Wind," which Gord Downie recorded with the band The Country of Miracles. A track-by-track preview of the album highlighted its rich lyrical content, filled with references and tributes to figures like Al Purdy, Alexander Solzhenitsyn, and even a "Custerian" in the Battle of Little Bighorn. "It's also on a solo record entitled The Grand Bounce from 2009."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This album, Gord Downie's third solo effort, was released in the summer of 2010, seven years after "The Battle of the Nudes." It featured the "Country of Miracles" as his backing band and was produced by Chris Walla of Death Cab for Cutie. "The Country of Miracles was back again for the grand bounts and the producer was Chris Walla of Death Cab for Cutie."
